subtopic_enhancements.interactive_sim_hook: Dynamic Torque-Speed Kloss Curve: Adjust rotor resistance R_2 and stator voltage V_s to visualize maximum torque T_max invariance and starting torque enhancement.
subtopic_enhancements.industry_relevance: Industrial traction drives, high-speed rail locomotive traction motors (Siemens Vectron), and permanent magnet synchronous wind turbine generators.
subtopic_enhancements.gate_pyq_mapping: GATE EE 2-Mark NAT: Air gap power P_gap, rotor copper loss s*P_gap, and slip calculation under variable load torque.
